mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.icon, c.create_time AS createTime, COUNT(a.id) AS articleCount FROM blog_category c LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON c.id = a.category_id AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
